Hi Laura / Procurement team,

Hope you’re well. Our existing Redwood subscription is up for renewal on 2027-12-15. Two housekeeping items we need to coordinate on Globex's side before then:

1) Procurement portal migration: Our internal procurement platform is migrating vendors to a new portal on 2027-11-20. Any vendor that hasn't re-onboarded by that date will be blocked from our PO flow. We need Redwood to complete the new vendor onboarding (attached) and provide a portal admin account or SSO metadata.

2) Q1 capacity uplift: The product team intends to increase committed capacity ~40% starting 2028-01-01 (estimate: additional 2M tokens/month). Procurement is asking for an updated mutual action plan and a target PO date so billing can align to quarter boundaries.

Can you confirm:
- Who will be our Redwood point of contact for the portal re-onboarding?
- Whether an amendment/term change is required if we push the seat/capacity uplift into Q1 (we may need a short-term PO for the uplift only)?
- A list of attestation docs you can share (SOC2, data flow, W-9) so we can complete vendor risk checks ahead of the cutover.

I've attached the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and our procurement checklist. If we can get a MAP and a PO target by 2027-11-17, procurement will be able to process the PO before the portal cutover.

Thanks — cc'ing Ben Collins (IT procurement) so we can coordinate the portal admin steps.

Best,
